calls.statement:
SELECT 
  fsw.week_ending_date,
  SUM(fsw.closing_value) as weekly_total_value
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsw.store_key = ds.store_key
WHERE dp.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
  AND dp.is_current = TRUE
  AND fsw.week_ending_date BETWEEN '2026-06-29' AND '2026-08-02'
  AND ds.store_id < 900
GROUP BY fsw.week_ending_date
ORDER BY fsw.week_ending_date

WITH weekly_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    fsw.week_ending_date,
    SUM(fsw.closing_value) as weekly_total_value
  FROM fact_stock_week fsw
  INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
  INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsw.store_key = ds.store_key
  WHERE dp.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
    AND dp.is_current = TRUE
    AND fsw.week_ending_date BETWEEN '2026-06-29' AND '2026-08-02'
    AND ds.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY fsw.week_ending_date
)
SELECT AVG(weekly_total_value) as average_stock_value_eur
FROM weekly_totals
